# Customer requirement: browse a local shop

Let a shopper choose Ontario, open Maple Market, and view its Notebook.
The chosen region must remain Ontario when the shopper visits the store.
The Notebook detail page must identify Maple Market as its seller and show
“In stock”. The user must not need to sign in or add anything to a basket.

Acceptance checks must come from this brief. Page inspection can establish
accessible control names and destinations, but must not replace expected
region, seller or stock status with whatever the implementation displays.
